release_notes: Browser check (⚙ → Settings → Bots): bots, moderators' virtual machines, emulators and anti-detect browsers caught by contradictions the browser reports about itself — a software GPU, a phone User-Agent on a desktop platform, a phone without touch, automation markers. Modes Off / Observe only / Soft (recommended) / Strict, each with its risk explained. In cloak streams with the JavaScript check on, a suspicious browser gets the safe page before the money page; elsewhere the click is marked as a bot, with no extra hop for real visitors. Real phones, including FB / Instagram / TikTok in-app browsers, raise nothing, and the fingerprint is never used for uniqueness. The click card shows the verdict and its signs; a cloak stream can opt out. This update leaves the check off: an admin banner offers to turn on the soft mode with one click.
